answer_1.quote: We select two generative tasks to evaluate cross-lingual zero-shot knowledge transfer: • XL-Sum: news summarization on the XL-Sum dataset . The model needs to generate a 1-2 sentences summary based on a 1-2 news paragraphs. • XQuAD: question answering dataset , the model needs to generate a short phrase answer based on a paragraph and a question about it appended in the end of the paragraph.

answer_2.quote: For summarization, we report the ROUGE-2 metric , and for QA, we report F-measure.
